Infectious disease modeler developing data-driven models to inform public health policy. I led modeling that informed COVID-19 school-reopening strategies in the Netherlands and contributed to the pandemic response in the United Kingdom. My work integrates genomic, environmental, and clinical data across diverse health systems, including national tuberculosis surveillance in Brazil and U.S. Veterans Affairs antimicrobial resistance surveillance.
